schedule: Six simulator fault families and normal, each at each fixed probe count
exposure_rule: Freeze all inputs before any provider run. No development smoke uses these IDs.
controls: Derive insufficient evidence and counter evidence from the three normal parents using v1 transforms.
injection_track: Separate predeclared adversarial probes and deterministic quarantine checks. Separate denominator.
failure_rule: Preserve failed attempts. Stop if baseline or cleanup cannot be verified. No failed capture is silently substituted.
scope: New workload observations of known local fault families
